newsitem.title: USA: El Chico has two suitors.
newsitem.headline: El Chico has two suitors.

text.p: El Chico Restaurants Inc said Thursday it had received two separate unsolicited expressions of interest about acquiring the company.
El Chico did not identify the suitors and gave no details about their approaches.
It said its board had created an independent special committee to review the matter.

The Dallas-based owner and franchisor of Mexican restaurants said the committee had retained Montgomery Securities as an investment banker to advise it and to evaluate various strategic and financial alternatives to maximize shareholder value.
